regulation.title: 2026 regulations
regulation.body: There is no DRS from 2026. For now, the public timing data does not include some of the 2026 rule changes: each car’s active aerodynamics (straight or corner mode), when each driver uses overtake mode or Boost, and each car’s battery charge or the energy it deploys. Only race control enabling or disabling overtake mode for the whole track is published, when it announces it: it shows as “{chip}” in the header and on the timeline.
